title: Indian Army NCC Special Entry 125th Course Women (April 2027)
post_name: Short Service Commission (Non-Tech) Officer - Lieutenant (NCC Special Entry, Women)
short_info: Indian Army NCC Special Entry for unmarried women graduates holding the NCC 'C' certificate, including wards of battle casualties, for the April 2027 course at OTA Chennai. Applications have closed; SSB interviews are planned for November/December 2026.
age_limit: 19 to 25 years as on 01 Jan 2027
qualification: Bachelor's degree (final-year students may apply) and NCC 'C' certificate with minimum 'B' grade, with 2-3 years in NCC Senior Division/Wing.

title: Indian Army JAG Entry Scheme 125th Course (April 2027)
post_name: Short Service Commission (JAG) Officer - Lieutenant
short_info: Indian Army Judge Advocate General entry for unmarried male and female law graduates with a CLAT PG 2026 score, for the April 2027 course at OTA Chennai. Applications have closed; SSB interviews are planned for November/December 2026.
age_limit: 21 to 27 years as on 01 Jan 2027
qualification: LLB with minimum 55% aggregate marks, CLAT PG 2026 score mandatory, and eligibility for registration as an advocate with the Bar Council.

title: Indian Navy SSC Officers June 2027 (AT-27) Course
post_name: SSC Officers - Executive (GS(X)/Hydro, Pilot, Observer, ATC, Logistics, NAIC), Education, Engineering, Electrical, Naval Constructor
short_info: Indian Navy Short Service Commission intake for unmarried men and women across executive, education and technical branches, for the course starting June 2027 at INA Ezhimala. Applications have closed; SSB interviews are scheduled for November-December 2026.
age_limit: Varies by branch (e.g. GS(X)/Hydro: born between 02 Jul 2002 and 01 Jan 2008)
qualification: BE/B.Tech with minimum 60% for most branches; MBA/B.Sc/B.Com/MCA/M.Sc options for Logistics and MSc/MA/ME/M.Tech options for Education, as specified.

title: CAPF Medical Officer Selection Board (MOSB) 2025 - 282 Posts
post_name: Super Specialist Medical Officer (2IC), Specialist Medical Officer (DC), Medical Officer (AC)
short_info: ITBP is running the Medical Officer Selection Board-2025 to fill 282 medical officer posts in BSF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB and Assam Rifles. Online applications closed on 8 Sep 2026; documentation and interview dates are yet to be announced.
age_limit: Super Specialist: max 50 yrs; Specialist: max 40 yrs; Medical Officer: max 30 yrs (as on closing date; relaxation as per rules)
qualification: MBBS with internship and medical registration; PG degree/diploma plus experience for Specialists; DM/M.Ch plus experience for Super Specialists.

title: CRPF Sports Quota Head Constable and Constable (GD) Recruitment 2026
post_name: Head Constable (GD) and Constable (GD) - Sports Quota
short_info: CRPF invites meritorious sportspersons for 521 posts (182 Head Constable/GD and 339 Constable/GD) under the sports quota. Online applications will be accepted from 12 Oct to 11 Nov 2026 on the CRPF recruitment website.
age_limit: 18 to 23 years as on 01.08.2026 (relaxation as per notification)
qualification: HC/GD: 10+2 or equivalent; CT/GD: Matriculation or equivalent; plus the sports achievements specified in the notification.
fee_info: Rs 100 for UR/OBC/EWS male candidates; women, SC/ST and ex-servicemen are exempt.

title: Indian Coast Guard Group B Civilian Recruitment 2026 (Foreman of Stores)
post_name: Foreman of Stores (Group B, Pay Level 6)
short_info: The Indian Coast Guard Directorate of Recruitment invites offline applications for 4 Foreman of Stores posts at Karwar, Minicoy, Pipavav and Bhubaneswar. Applications must reach by ordinary post by 3 Nov 2026; selection includes a written exam.
age_limit: 18 to 30 years as on last date (ST 5 yrs; Govt servants up to 5 yrs relaxation)
qualification: Master's in Economics/Commerce/Statistics/Business Studies/Public Admin with 1 yr stores experience, or Bachelor's/diploma in related field with 2 yrs experience.

title: Indian Coast Guard Region (West) Civilian Recruitment 01/2026
post_name: Store Keeper Grade II, Engine Driver, Lascar, Civilian MT Driver (OG), MTS (Peon), MTS (Chowkidar)
short_info: Coast Guard Region (West), Mumbai invites offline applications for six Group C civilian posts with one vacancy each. Applications must reach by ordinary post by 3 Nov 2026; shortlisted candidates take a written exam and, where applicable, a trade test.
age_limit: 18-25, 18-27 or 18-30 years depending on post (relaxation as per Govt rules)
qualification: 10th or 12th pass depending on post, plus post-specific requirements such as Engine Driver competency certificate, HMV/LMV licence and relevant experience.

title: UPSC Engineering Services (Preliminary) Examination 2027
post_name: Group A/B engineering services and posts in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
short_info: UPSC Engineering Services Exam 2027 (Notice No. 02/2027-ENGG.) recruits engineers to central government services in four engineering categories. The Main exam is scheduled for 18.06.2027. About 480 vacancies are expected, including 19 for PwBD candidates.
age_limit: 21-30 years as on 01.01.2027 (born 02.01.1997 to 01.01.2006); relaxations as per rules
qualification: Degree in Engineering from a recognised university, or an equivalent qualification listed in the notice (e.g. Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) exam).
fee_info: Rs. 200; no fee for Female/SC/ST/PwBD candidates

title: UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist (Preliminary) Examination 2027
post_name: Geologist, Chemist, Assistant Geologist, Assistant Geophysicist, Assistant Chemist (GSI); Scientist B and Assistant Hydrogeologist/Chemist/Geophysicist (CGWB)
short_info: UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Exam 2027 (Notice No. 01/2027-GEOL) fills Group A and B posts in the Geological Survey of India and the Central Ground Water Board. There are 127 tentative vacancies. The Main exam is scheduled for 19-20.06.2027.
age_limit: 21-32 years as on 01.01.2027 (born 02.01.1995 to 01.01.2006); relaxations as per rules
qualification: Post-wise Master's degree: Geology/allied subjects (Geologist, Hydrogeology posts), Physics/Geophysics (Geophysicist), Chemistry (Chemist posts), as detailed in the notice.
fee_info: Rs. 200; no fee for Female/SC/ST/PwBD candidates

title: UPSC Indian Forest Service (Main) Examination 2026
post_name: Indian Forest Service (IFS)
short_info: IFS Main 2026 is the written stage for candidates who qualified the IFS (Preliminary) Exam 2026, held through CS(P) 2026 (result 15.06.2026). About 80 vacancies are expected. The time table was released on 17.09.2026.
age_limit: 21-32 years as on 01.08.2026 (born 02.08.1994 to 01.08.2005); relaxations as per rules
qualification: Bachelor's degree with at least one of Animal Husbandry & Vet. Science, Botany, Chemistry, Geology, Maths, Physics, Statistics, Zoology; or Bachelor's in Agriculture, Forestry or Engineering.
fee_info: Rs. 100 (preliminary) plus Rs. 200 for the Main exam; Female/SC/ST/PwBD exempt

title: UPSC Recruitment Advt. No. 12/2026
post_name: Assistant Legislative Counsel, Law Officer (GNCTD), Junior Technical Officer (Sugar Technology), Specialist Grade II (Cardiology, NDMC)
short_info: UPSC Advertisement 12/2026 invites online applications through ORA for 13 vacancies across 4 posts: 8 Assistant Legislative Counsel, 3 Law Officer, 1 Junior Technical Officer (Sugar Technology) and 1 Specialist Grade II Cardiology. Interview dates will be announced separately.
age_limit: Post-wise: 30 yrs (UR)/33 yrs (OBC) for Asst. Legislative Counsel & Law Officer; 38 yrs (OBC) for JTO; 48 yrs (OBC) for Specialist Gr II; PwBD +10 yrs
qualification: Post-wise as per advertisement (e.g. law qualifications for legal posts; science/engineering degree with Sugar Technology qualification for JTO).
fee_info: Rs. 25; no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates

title: UPSC Recruitment Advt. No. 11/2026
post_name: Assistant Public Prosecutor (GNCTD), Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine, Anatomy), Public Law Officer (Ladakh), Assistant Editor, Specialist Grade II (NDMC)
short_info: UPSC Advertisement 11/2026 covers 212 vacancies across 7 posts, including 140 Assistant Public Prosecutors in Delhi and 60 Assistant Professors (General Medicine). A 15.09.2026 clarification covers OBC reservation for the Delhi APP post.
age_limit: Post-wise, e.g. APP (GNCTD): 35 yrs UR/EWS, 38 OBC, 40 SC/ST; Asst. Professor (Gen. Medicine): 40 UR/EWS, 43 OBC, 45 SC/ST; PwBD relaxation as applicable
qualification: Post-wise, e.g. APP: law degree + 3 years' experience at the bar; Assistant Professor: recognised MBBS plus qualifications/experience specified in the advertisement.
fee_info: Rs. 25; no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates

title: UPSC EPFO Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner Recruitment (Special Advt. 52/2026)
post_name: Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC), EPFO
short_info: UPSC Special Advertisement 52/2026 covers 80 APFC vacancies in EPFO, Ministry of Labour & Employment (Level 10). Candidates are shortlisted for interview through a pen-and-paper Recruitment Test on 20.12.2026.
age_limit: 35 yrs (UR/EWS), 38 yrs (OBC), 40 yrs (SC/ST); PwBD +10 yrs (max 56)
qualification: Degree of a recognised university or equivalent. Desirable: Diploma in Company Law/Labour Laws/Public Administration.
fee_info: Rs. 25; no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates

title: UPSC Delhi Principal & Vice Principal Recruitment (Special Advt. 51/2026)
post_name: Principal, Vice Principal (Education Department, GNCTD)
short_info: UPSC Special Advertisement 51/2026 covers 124 Principal and 704 Vice Principal vacancies in the Delhi Education Department. Candidates are shortlisted for interview through a pen-and-paper Combined Recruitment Test on 01.11.2026.
age_limit: Principal: 50 (UR/EWS), 53 (OBC), 55 (SC/ST); Vice Principal: 35 (UR/EWS), 38 (OBC), 40 (SC/ST); PwBD +10 yrs (max 56)
qualification: Master's degree + B.Ed. Principal: 10 years' teaching experience; Vice Principal: 2 years as PGT or 3 years as TGT.
fee_info: Rs. 25; no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates

title: UPSC Advt. 05/2026 Combined Recruitment Test: IMD Scientist-B & MSME Assistant Director
post_name: Scientist-B (Atmospheric Sciences, General Meteorology, Instrumentation), IMD; Assistant Director Grade-I & Grade-II (IEDS), MSME
short_info: UPSC will hold a pen-and-paper Combined Recruitment Test (English only) on 11.10.2026, 2-4 PM, for 12 posts under Advt. 05/2026: 46 IMD Scientist-B and 26 MSME Assistant Director vacancies.
age_limit: Post-wise, e.g. Scientist-B (General Meteorology): 35 (UR/EWS), 38 (OBC), 40 (SC/ST); PwBD +10 yrs
qualification: Post-wise as per Advt. 05/2026, e.g. Master's in Science (Maths/Physics/Meteorology etc.) for Scientist-B; Master's in Chemistry or Chemical Engg. degree for AD (Chemical).
fee_info: Rs. 25; no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates

title: UPSC Advt. 06/2026 Recruitment Test: IB Deputy Central Intelligence Officer (Technical)
post_name: Deputy Central Intelligence Officer (DCIO) (Technical), Intelligence Bureau, MHA
short_info: UPSC will hold a pen-and-paper Recruitment Test (English only) on 11.10.2026, 9:30-11:30 AM, for 6 DCIO (Technical) vacancies in the Intelligence Bureau (UR-3, EWS-2, OBC-1). E-admit cards are due one week before the test.
age_limit: 35 yrs (UR/EWS), 38 yrs (OBC)
qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics/ECE/Telecom/CS/IT or related, or AMIE/AMIETE (ECE), or M.Sc Physics with Electronics/Telecom, or MCA/M.Sc (IT/CS/Software).
fee_info: Rs. 25; no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates

title: UPSC Advt. 13/2025 Legal Posts (Dept. of Legal Affairs): Selection via Recruitment Test
post_name: Additional/Deputy/Assistant Legal Adviser; Additional/Deputy/Assistant Government Advocate (Dept. of Legal Affairs)
short_info: UPSC has switched six Department of Legal Affairs posts under Advt. 13/2025 (38 vacancies) from scrutiny-plus-interview to a Recruitment Test, cancelling earlier scrutiny. The RT date is still awaited.
age_limit: Post-wise: 40-50 yrs (UR) depending on post, with category relaxations as per Advt. 13/2025
qualification: Degree in Law of a recognised university or equivalent, plus post-specific experience as per Advt. 13/2025.
fee_info: Rs. 25; SC/ST/PwBD/Women exempt (application window closed)
